title: Agnus Dei (Lassus, Missa Susanne un jour)
desc: Orlande de Lassus, Missa Susanne un jour, Agnus Dei, 1570. 5 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Tenor Secundus, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
